note: The 'A little shorter' button. Whole sentences gone, every specific detail kept — that is the instruction, and a fixture that trimmed adjectives instead would let a regression through.

response.openingLine: Thank you all for coming. Ruth would have said you shouldn't have gone to any trouble.
body: Some of you set off before it was light. She would have counted this room, and then told me she wasn't counting.
Ruth never explained herself. The house was warm, there was always one more chair, and if you turned up at half past nine with a story it got listened to right through.
One of the first things I was told about her was this: "{{memory:0}}" That was {{memoryFrom:0}}. I have never found it to be untrue.
Not one large heroic thing. Thousands of small ones, done quietly, for people who mostly never knew.
response.closingLine: So: no fuss, and a cup of tea. Thank you for being here for her.
